scope: two independently evolved two-phase numerical crack paths (soft, stiff), two 4-mm increments each from the WP2 straight crack; direct-versus-path decomposition of G; conditional on assumed crack advance; no onset, toughness, arrest, CZM, State 3

start.parentK: full-precision KI_perkN/KII_perkN of the PR #38 S0 material record, recomputed bitwise at ROOT creation

recurrence: theta = g2_mts_direction(KI_perkN, KII_perkN); t_new = cos(theta) t + sin(theta) n, n = R(+90) t; tip_new = tip + 4 t_new (identical to g2_trajectory_run local_forecast)
phase: g2_material_phase_stage (copy of the PR #38 phase stage): g2_material_phase_map + g2_material_phase_verify + check_g2_m2_phase_controls, G2_MATERIAL_POLICY_v1 tolerances; no reuse of labels from any other mesh
sif: g2_material_sif_on_mesh, unchanged, with G2_TRAJECTORY_POLICY_v1 BVP and verification thresholds (read only): blind COD first, five-annulus EDI, matrix E and nu, q support matrix only, residual, statics, energy, interface balance, annulus resultant, opening, K_II sign gate, 4x4 vs 6x6
records: ROOT, then per step: mesh MAT, PHASE_MAP record, SOLUTION record, REVIEW record, STATE record (g2_trajectory_record manifests); HOLD record on failure; review and state reuse re-verify forecast, mesh hash and content, 34/34 re-audit, phase re-map and verifier, parent and source hashes, without FEM

decomposition.G: (KI_raw^2 + KII_raw^2)/E_m at P = 1 N (EDI 6x6 annulus 0.4-2.6 mm); COD and J as secondary estimators

uncertainty.ratioPrimary: U = max(contour spread of the ratio, |ratio_4x4 - ratio|, |ratio_COD - ratio|, U_mesh for cross-mesh ratios); resolved iff |R-1| > 2U and the COD ratio has the same sign
uncertainty.U_mesh: cross-mesh floor at identical geometry from PR #38: |G_H1(S2alt)/G_H1(S2) - 1|
uncertainty.ratioConservative: R*(dG_a + dG_b), dG = |G_EDI - G_COD|/G_EDI of the two terms; reported and classified
uncertainty.pathSeparation: at s = 29.4 and 33.4 mm: tip separation |tip_M - tip_H| and signed lateral offset (tip_M - tip_H).n_H; U_sep(29.4) = 4 U_dTheta0, U_sep(33.4) = 8 U_dTheta0 + 4 U_dTheta1 (radians x mm), U_dTheta = max(|dTheta_COD - dTheta|, |dTheta_4x4 - dTheta|, contour spread of dTheta) of theta_M - theta_H at the matched parents; resolved iff separation > 2 U_sep; conservative variant uses |theta_EDI - theta_COD|_M + |theta_EDI - theta_COD|_H
uncertainty.steering: local MTS angles are compared only within one state's own frame; global terminal tangents reported separately

robustness.altMesh: at each material's M2 geometry, one alternative mesh with ExteriorOptions plus 'GuideHface_mm',1.0,'Hmax_mm',5 (as PR #38 S2alt), all gates; R_path_alt = G_M,alt[Gamma_M2]/G_M,S2alt[Gamma_H S2] (PR #38 S2alt record)
robustness.ROBUST: same sign of R_path - 1 and |dRpath_alt - dRpath| <= 0.25 |dRpath| + 2 U_mesh
robustness.pathSeparationRobustness: not measured (no alternative full path); path separation reported as a single-mesh-family numerical observation

comparability: chord counts and band polygon areas of every new mesh recorded; geometry-equivalent iff 3x76 chords and band area within 1e-4 relative of S2; otherwise flagged
faults: forged review with another step's or material's mesh
phase labels inconsistent with the saved polygons
q domain reaching a band (phase controls)
wrong parent hash or parent K
interrupt after review and after state
forbidden: seeding material paths from homogeneous K
reusing labels, U or K across meshes
onset, toughness, arrest, CZM, experimental claims
